evidence: The as-deposited films were amorphous but the crystallization of Bi–Si–O thin films was initiated at 600 1C regardless of the atmosphere. The best crystallinity was obtained when films were annealed at 800 1C in a nitrogen atmosphere on MgO-buffered Si(1 0 0). The resulting films were crystalline a-axis-oriented orthorhombic Bi2SiO5.
